name: Raze to the Ground
oracle_text:
This spell can't be countered.
Destroy target artifact. If its mana value was 1 or less, draw a card.

rulings.comment: "This spell can't be countered" means it can't be countered even by the ward keyword ability. The spell's controller may still pay the ward cost if it targets an artifact with ward, but Raze to the Ground won't be countered if they don't.
